MRB with spironolactone or eplerenone should be considered in all patients with HF and LVSD post-MI.

The main takeaway from our work is that

aldosterone blockade should be considered early post-MI in patients with LVSD and HF, irrespective of the type of MI, and even in patients treated with optimal medical therapy, including ACE inhibitors/ARBs.
the benefits of aldosterone blockade are not restricted to patients with HF and that MRB should be considered in all patients with an MI, including those who do not have HF.
MRBs are safe and efficacious in the post-MI population, but that the timing and dose are important.
